newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in slow activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in slow activity.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were mixed Friday, capping a week of featureless activity, dealers said.
They said the forecast for milder weather for Kansas to Texas could hamper demand for midds.
Warm weather, with temperatures nearing 70 degrees Fahrenheit, was forecast for Kansas to Texas through the weekend.
"Millfeed business has been spotty," a Kansas City dealer said.

A Carolinas dealer said buyers (feedmills) were very reluctant to be in the market. "I think they have got their needs booked for February and March. I think the only thing we will see now is fill in (orders)."
Another Minneapolis dealer agreed, saying there was no trading because the needs by the feedmixers were covered.
"Maybe we can hold this current level for a day or two but I don't think it will last very long," a Missouri dealer said. "I think the runup was fueled by the lack of runtime in the flour mills."
